text:
Sam: Heads-up: canary for search-service-prod paused by deploy-bot during postupgrade hooks. values checksum mismatch for tenant-acme.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary paused for HelmRelease "search-service-prod" stage=postupgrade-hooks. Reason: values-checksum mismatch (expected=0x7a9f4, actual=0xb2c1d). Resume options: annotate with release.redwood/resume=true or commit a values pin.

Talia: Chart bumped to v2.4.1 earlier. Is this overlay drift or chart change?

Jordan: Overlay drift. tenant-acme overlay sets hpa.minReplicas=0 (scale-to-zero) which makes the postupgrade job wait for pods that won't be created.

Maria: Can we capture job logs for release notes? Jordan, paste the command.

Jordan: logs:
kubectl logs job/postupgrade-search-1832 -n prod
# shows job waiting for pods, timeout 5m

Jordan: Plan: push overlay patch to force tenants.acme.hpa.minReplicas=1 and redeploy via pipeline. Ops shortcut: annotate to resume then patch. Prefer commit for traceability.

Release Manager: Approve +15m change-window extension to finish the hotfix. Keep release notes concise.

Jordan: Pushed overlay patch commit 9f2a3b, pipeline triggered. Helm output: postupgrade job completed, new pod ready, canary progressing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary resumed and completed 10%->50%->100%. Metrics stable for 12m.

Talia: Decision: no rollback. We'll pin chart search-service@v2.4.1 and record values-hash=0xb2c1d in release manifest. Add SRE follow-up to scan overlays for scale-to-zero entries that break postupgrade hooks.

Sam: Added release-tracker comment and annotated the HelmRelease. Closing thread, canary healthy. :thumbsup:
